scope_limits: Recorded-identity reconstruction verifies artifact consistency, not independent authentication of backend execution.
No original-Luna cross-model parity comparison; separately assigned reviewer owns that check.
No prediction outputs or trace bodies, private labels, provider APIs or live SQLite reads.

verification_recipe.comparison: Full reconstructed ProfileArtifact.to_dict equals actual saved profile and result.profile
verification_recipe.documents: Exact sparse release.sources.documents, verified against canonical release byte pin
verification_recipe.extractor_identity: NoCalls stub with _overnight_identity equal to executed manifest.extractor; complete() raises
verification_recipe.passages: Each exact text equals source content[start:end] and lies within one permitted span
verification_recipe.semantic_bundle: Complete packet config embedding_bundle equals exact sparse index-pinned bundle and request regenerated by frozen retrieval._embedding_request
